SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

2. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   C. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.

3. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   C. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.

4. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   D. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   C. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

7. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.

8. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   C. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

11. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   B. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Economic activities in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Industries in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise Project at School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
